title: Minimal PostgreSQL epoch-publication implementation + transactional/adversarial tests
objective: A versioned moonshot schema and guarded publication (expected parent + chain generation) that is idempotent for identical results, preserves and classifies disagreements, refuses stale advancement, keeps validation separate and attempt accounting durable; tested for concurrency, rollback, lost acknowledgement and crash recovery.
problem: Git-CAS publication is replaced by the program's PostgreSQL; the semantics of C-008 must survive the change of transport.
non_goals: a Moonshot lease table (Fabric's leases are the authority)
evidence_required: GREEN on the canonical cluster in throwaway schemas

acceptance.condition: all pass; C-008 identity tests still pass
